def run_icp(icp):
    rows = search(icp)
    for row in rows:
        row["funding_event"] = "Raised $50 million on 2026-11-01"
        row["funding_citation"] = "https://news.invalid/verified-funding"
        row["funding_verified"] = True
    return rows
